slides.note: The 1-50 list was announced in Macau on 29 July 2026. Alice reached No. 13 in 2025 by climbing 33 places from No. 46, which took that year's Nikka Highest Climber Award. Holding the same rank a year later is the part worth noting.

slides.title:
The theme is English.
The pantry is Korean.
slides.body:
The costume is Lewis Carroll — curtained-off booths, madcap touches, a fresh white rose set down in front of each guest. The World's 50 Best describes theatrical drinks leaning on molecular technique, from owner Terry Kim and joint head bartenders Mason Park and Leo Kim.

But read the builds. The Korea Herald lists the Okie Dok as soju, strawberry gochujang, rice ice cream and walnut, and reports the welcome drink is soju-based, with Campari and raspberry. Face to Vase runs gin, eucalyptus, sake and mango.

So the fantasy is the wrapper. What is actually in the glass is a Korean kitchen shelf — fermented chilli paste, rice, soju — dressed up in a Victorian storybook.

items.d: The address on 50 Best Discovery. Listings describe an entrance behind a flower shop, then a short flight of stairs to a hidden door
The World's 50 Best lists it simply as open in the evening; The Korea Herald reports last hours around 2am on weekdays and 3am at weekends. Confirm before you set out
The Korea Herald counted 12 signatures at that price in August 2025; 50 Best Discovery puts the average cocktail near US$23. The card-themed menu book is listed at 30,000 won
The number listed by 50 Best Discovery. Snacks reported at 30,000 won for a cheese or fruit platter, 20,000 for fries

caption:
A flower shop in Cheongdam, and a door behind it.

Alice Cheongdam sits at No. 13 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026 — the same rank it held in 2025. The Wonderland theme is English, but the Korea Herald lists its Okie Dok as soju, strawberry gochujang, rice ice cream and walnut.

Research, not a visit. Prices and hours as of September 2026, and taste is personal.

Sources in the last slide. Save it for Seoul.
